recentDishes.title: Chicken Adobo

substitutions.substitute: Rice vinegar (unseasoned) ~$3.50 at Kroger, or white vinegar + pinch sugar
Kikkoman at Kroger ~$3 — Silver Swan at Asian grocer for authentic
Dried bay leaves at Kroger — no substitution needed
Kroger spice aisle — no substitution needed
Fresh garlic at Kroger — no substitution needed

recentDishes.feedback: Jordan's example: a Filipino dish to make in Cincinnati
recentDishes.context: The whole point of the substitution engine — knowing the substitute is what matters more than price
recentDishes.method: Classic adobo: braise chicken in soy + vinegar + garlic + bay leaves + peppercorns until tender. Simmer to reduce.

recentDishes.title: Beef Caldereta

substitutions.substitute: Chicken/tomato liver pâté from Kroger deli (~$4); caldereta works without it if needed
Maggi liquid OR MSG (Accent) / chicken bouillon (~$3)
Authentic brand at Jungle Jim's / CAM / Amazon (~$3)
Kikkoman at Kroger (~$3) — Silver Swan at Asian grocers for authentic

recentDishes.feedback: Comfort food — proper Filipino dinner after a long workday
recentDishes.context: Friday evening — got home from work, cooked caldereta for family dinner
recentDishes.method: Marinate beef in soy sauce. Fry the beef. Boil in water until tender. Add tomato sauce, liver spread, Maggi Sarap, and Mama Sita's Caldereta mix. Add carrots and bell pepper. Cook until carrots are soft. Serve for dinner.

recentDishes.title: Chicken Tinola

substitutions.substitute: Baby spinach (~$3) — moringa/malunggay at Asian grocers if available
Chayote IS in US Kroger produce (~$1.50); else zucchini
Fresh jalapeño or serrano at Kroger
Whole peppercorns, ground fresh at Kroger

recentDishes.feedback: Delicious and perfect for rainy weather — classic Filipino comfort food
recentDishes.context: Sunday family dinner — Filipino family day
recentDishes.method: Sauté garlic, onion, crushed pepper, and ginger. Add chicken and sear. Add water, bring to boil, add salt (or fish sauce if no salt). Boil until chicken is cooked. Add chili leaves, cook 10 seconds. Serve hot.
